items.name: CECOS Admission Portal
items.description: A dynamic web application for managing admissions at CECOS University, connected with Supabase, with application processing, admission tracking, PayPro payment integration, and role-based dashboards for the Admissions and Finance offices.

items.name: Forge, Multi-Agent AI App Builder
items.description: In-browser multi-agent system that generates working apps from natural language, coordinating five agents (Clarifier, Designer, Data Agent, Builder, Verifier) with a self-healing loop that detects and repairs build failures autonomously. Built at the CMPO x CDGAI Agentic Hackathon.

items.name: Hunar Storee Landing Page
items.description: A responsive landing page for Hunar Storee, a Charsadda based Vocational Training Institute for women, built with Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: Pocket Sized Stories Website
items.description: A Next.js website for my art and craft business, showing products, reviews, and a contact and order form, with an admin dashboard to add or remove products and set pricing and descriptions. Deployed on Vercel.

items.name: Aqua Sentinel
items.description: IoT and AI-based water leakage detection system (Final Year Project). Flow, pH, TDS, and turbidity sensors feed an ANN model deployed on Streamlit Cloud for real-time leak detection and potability analysis, with Gemini API insights in a Flutter app. Won 2nd Place at CECOS University Open House 2026.

items.name: Tap to Care
items.description: Bluetooth-enabled sanitary pad dispenser with fingerprint authentication and a companion Flutter app that lets non-technical staff enroll fingerprints directly, backed by a Firebase admin panel. Used by ~50 female staff at NIC Peshawar.

items.name: TOOP Certificate Generator and Verification Portal
items.description: Secure certificate admin portal built for Devthon Hackathon (TOOP) — generates themed certificates with live preview and PDF export, supports CSV-driven batch generation, and pairs with a verification portal that authenticates each certificate via its unique ID and embedded QR code.

items.name: DNA Gen
items.description: Product-authenticity app built for a Saudi startup that detects counterfeit or tampered products by validating steganographically embedded metadata in product images, using a Railway-deployed Python backend.

items.name: Home Automation System
items.description: Smart home IoT prototype controlling lights, locks, and climate from one app.

items.name: Portfolio Site
items.description: This very site built with React, Tailwind, and Framer Motion.

items.name: Python Web Scraper Toolkit
items.description: Hybrid Python pipeline that extracts and cleans data from 200+ university websites into standardized JSON.

items.name: SAHA (NGO) Website UI Design
items.description: Redesigned a modern, user friendly donor-facing UI in Figma for SAHA, a local NGO focused on Sustainability, and implemented the Flutter screens for cross-platform use.

items.name: Quran App
items.description: A mobile app for reading to the Quran, in a GenZ style keeping a person hooked to reciting, bookmarks the ayat where you left off, built with Flutter, for personal use.
